ops.title: 2026-07-18 full-history rewrite: cargo build dirs purged, all SHAs changed
ops.body:
**What happened:** the tip of main (`36e10676`) had accidentally committed `target-cargo/` (3.6GB, 12,067 files); `.cargo-target/` (~500MB) sat in a jj keep-ref wip commit; and 59.8MB of `target/` release artifacts had been in pushed history since the scaffold commit (added `6956b33d`, deleted `8d1b11e0`).

**What was done:**
- Tip rewritten jj-natively (untrack + squash) before it ever reached origin, then `git filter-repo --invert-paths --path target --path target-cargo --path .cargo-target` over the full history.
- **Every commit SHA changed.** Old main tip `828e98ca` → `a7ade7e9`. Force-pushed: `main`, `release/v13.2`, `fix/lift-degrades-malformed-tool-input`, and all ~40 `v*` tags. `release-pypi.yml` was disabled during the tag push — zero release runs fired.
- Verified trees byte-identical pre/post (main tree `24fee327`, tag trees for v0.1.0/v13.2.0/v14.0.0 unchanged); 465 commits preserved; remote main tree confirmed clean via GitHub API.
- 13 stale `.claude/worktrees/` checkouts removed (they pinned pre-rewrite objects); uncommitted spike prototypes preserved — see the "spike worktree rescue" log.
- Local `.git`: 1.6G → 30M. jj re-initialized colocated (op history reset).

**Consequences for other clones/sessions:** any pre-2026-07-18 clone or worktree must re-clone or `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/<branch>`; old SHAs in issues/PR bodies no longer resolve. GitHub's `refs/pull/*` still hold pre-rewrite ancestry server-side (not fetched by clones; only GitHub support can purge).

**Prevention:** `.gitignore` now ignores `target/`, `target-cargo/`, `.cargo-target/` unanchored (commit `a7ade7e9`); same entries added to `~/.gitignore_global` and the repo-bootstrap base gitignore template (cc-skills `c8bc79b`).
